source_revision: 8eff1aa with previously recorded configuration/test overlays; no core edits in this gate run
scope: Host 156, single-node A6000 native/DDP CLIP candidate. No claim for other backends, models or devices.
restart_limits: Real pretrained 151277313-parameter CLIP, FP32, Flickr8k-labeled 6000-pair WDS; non-synthetic payload checked. Scenario key clip-datacomp-golden is a launcher template, not the dataset identity.
SIGKILL targeted the dedicated launcher process group after step 20 publication. This does not cover killing an individual rank, interrupting a partial write or exhausting disk capacity.
These gates verify successful continuation to step 100 and valid final checkpoints. No uninterrupted step-100 parameter comparison was performed in this round.

Runtime artifact paths inherited from the base config were isolated with dedicated kill2-runtime/kill4-runtime Docker mounts over /experiment/flickr-persistent, protecting earlier results. Core scenario config currently does not isolate runtime.run_dir itself.

fp16_contract.scope: Existing distributed_checkpoint_contracts.py, small generated training case on real CUDA/NCCL; not CLIP quality or throughput

checks: python -I CLI help outside source tree
production 1gpu JSON dry-run outside source tree
packaging.limits: Local acceptance build keeps existing version 0.2.0; not published and no tag changed. This is not complete dependency installation or an installed-wheel GPU run.

resource_observations.measurement_method: Python tracemalloc around TrainEngine.record_step with measured CLIP metric keys and varying float loss. No GPU training; not process RSS or GPU memory.
resource_observations.data_resume: CLIP loader exposes no state protocol; currently replays all consumed micro-batches before resuming. Long-run recovery latency is not bounded by a production SLA.

required_before_production_acceptance: Bound checkpoint disk use while preserving validated recovery states and refusing unsafe deletion.
Bound retained metrics and preserve auditable streamed/aggregate observations.
Isolate run artifacts; validate data/config identity and bound data restoration latency.
Use disjoint, provenance-checked training and held-out retrieval data with agreed quality thresholds.
Measure repeated same-objective native PyTorch comparison and multi-GPU scaling.
Exercise individual-rank failure, partial checkpoint write and disk/I/O failure.
Complete at least 24 hours of actual stability observation with resource limits, then verify recovery and installed-package operation.
